name: listMap
description:
Calls the given closure with every element in the given list.
The function returns a list that contains all values returned by the closure.
syntax: listMap( string list, function closure, [string delimiter], [boolean includeEmptyFields], [boolean multiCharacterDelimiter], [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
filter can be a function/closure that implements the following constructor

[function(any value, number index, string list, string delimiter):any].

params.name: delimiter
params.description: delimiter used to separate the string list

params.name: multiCharacterDelimiter
params.description:
specifying whether the delimiters parameter specifies a multi-character delimiter.

If this parameter is true, the delimiters parameter must specify a single delimiter consisting of multiple characters.

This parameter enables the ListToArray function to convert a list such as the following to an array of color names: red:|orange:|yellow:|green:|blue:|indigo:|violet.

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
